official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – Consolidated Presidency compromise text

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: First formally published consolidated Council compromise in the AI Act procedure.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The official multilingual manifestation has a French cover and an English legislative annex. The English display title translates and preserves the cover's consolidated-version qualifier; the ordinal label and analytical corpus fields remain distinct.
